proves.claim: Claude has the first shipped runtime profile with a 1-hour cache, and a runtime outside the shipped profiles gets caching off.

settings.seat-runtime-profiles.shipped-p.why: Without it, a regression where a provider name is hard-coded or an unknown runtime launches with caching on would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: A Claude seat launches with the 1-hour cache and its lane tools, and a self-hosted seat with caching off and the same tools.

settings.seat-runtime-profiles.launch-ap.why: Without it, a regression where the launch configuration ignores the seat runtime profile would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: The board records cached versus fresh input where the provider reports it, and reads not reported where it does not.

settings.seat-runtime-profiles.cached-ve.why: Without it, a regression where an unreported provider shows a false zero for cached input would pass unnoticed.
